root_cause.text: The driver fails to re-anchor completed URBs to the `dev->rx_submitted` anchor list before resubmission, causing them to be missed when `ems_usb_close()` frees anchored URBs, resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called ... once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in ems_usb_close()." The patch adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted);` in `ems_usb_read_bulk_callback()` before resubmitting the URB to fix the leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Anchor URB before resubmission in read bulk callback to prevent use-after-free, and unanchor on failure.
intent_record.what: Added usb_anchor_urb() before submitting the URB, with an early return on success (skipping unanchor), and usb_unanchor_urb() on failure. Also changed the error logging condition from 'else if (retval)' to 'else'.
intent_record.how: Anchors the URB to dev->rx_submitted to keep it alive during submission. On success, returns immediately without unanchoring; on failure, unanchors the URB and still logs the error for any non-ENODEV error.

candidates.rationale: The URB is submitted without first re-anchoring it to dev->rx_submitted. This omission means the completed URB is not tracked in the anchor list, so ems_usb_close() cannot free it, causing a memory leak.
